messages:
Lia (design): quick mobile UX q — on narrow phones (~360px) the "Resources" table creates horizontal overflow. Proposal: turn the table into a swipe-up bottomsheet list at <=420px instead of squeezing columns.
Omar (frontend): +1 to bottomsheet for action-heavy rows. Reduces horizontal scroll. Concern: persistent top toolbar interaction?
Lia (design): toolbar stays pinned (search + breadcrumbs). Table becomes a sheet with rows + primary actions. Toolbar height reduces to 48px at <=420px.
Jess (product): will moving filters into the sheet hurt discoverability for power users?
Omar (frontend): keep a condensed filter pill in the toolbar that opens the sheet with the filter view active. That avoids two surfaces.
Alex (pm): keyboard behavior matters — on Android/iOS keyboard can push the sheet under the keyboard. Thoughts?
Lia (design): implement sheet max-height: calc(100vh - toolbarHeight - env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) and recompute on keyboard events. Also animate with translateY for better compositing.
Omar (frontend): similar worked in payments app. Quick snippet we used:
```
.sheet { max-height: calc(100vh - 56px); overflow: auto; }
window.addEventListener('resize', recomputeSheetHeight)
```
But iOS WKWebView quirks need testing.
Jess (product): copy nit: header "Resources" reads ambiguous. Suggest "Workloads" or "Models & Workloads".
Lia (design): prefer "Workloads" — concise and consistent.
Alex (pm): "Workloads" wins.
devex-bot: analytics: 22% of sessions for this page are <=420px (last 30d).
Lia (design): accessibility nits: when sheet opens, move focus into the sheet and trap it; add visible close button; ensure 44px tap targets for rows and actions.
Omar (frontend): will add aria-modal="true", set background inert, and include a skip link "Skip to content" in the toolbar.
Jess (product): handling long IDs/hashes: tooltips are bad on touch. Truncate with inline "Show" toggle instead.
Lia (design): truncate to 24 chars with ellipsis and provide inline expansion. For screen readers expose full text offscreen.
Omar (frontend): plan: 1) condense toolbar, 2) sheet with rows + primary CTA, 3) filter pill opens sheet prefiltered, 4) test keyboard behavior on iOS + Android. Prototype by Wed, accessibility review Thu.
Lia (design): any blockers?
Jess (product): none; add me to PR for copy.
Alex (pm): assign 2d spike to Omar. If successful, roll to mobile canary next sprint.
Lia (design): posting mock in #design after lunch — @Omar (frontend) please add prototype link when ready. :thumbsup:
Omar (frontend): will do.
